description: Physical phenomena nodes organized by domain (electric motors, mechanical faults). V1: brush DC, BLDC + PMSM, bearing/shaft/gear faults, friction, vibration sensor, generic fault modulator.

subPlugins.description: World-frame transform composer (world = parent_world × local). Acts as the base class shared by every Physics object that lives in a world reference frame: motors, sensors, mechanical bodies. Drop a standalone Transform on the canvas for intermediate frames, markers and debug attach-points. Environmental context (gravity, temperature, ...) is read from the session's SceneStateView, populated by the enclosing Sim.Graph or by the runner at root from the primary SceneItem.

Environment + atmospheric chemistry primitives. The Scene descriptor carries gravity / temperature / pressure / time_scale / local transform + references to wired solvers / atmosphere / shared nodes; consumed by Sim.Graph at session bind. Ships with 5 environmental presets (Earth, Moon, Mars, Orbital, ISS Cabin), an IIntegrable AtmosphereStateNode that tracks per-species mass inventory, and a 3-mode AtmosphereGate (closed / open_passive / hvac_forced) for coupling two atmospheres with native A↔B mass conservation.
Separately-excited brush DC motor: dynamic + steady-state, PI speed controller, tachymeter. Defaults tuned for MCSA pipelines (τ_e = 1 ms, stable to dt ≤ 100 µs).

3-phase brushless DC motor: trapezoidal back-EMF dynamic model with the characteristic 6f_e commutation ripple, 6-step inverter and speed PI controller. The sinusoidal-back-EMF counterpart lives in the PMSM family (Physics.Electric.Motor.PMSM:dynamic).

3-phase squirrel-cage asynchronous motor: alpha-beta space-vector dynamic model with emergent slip. Broken rotor bars are modeled as a rotor-fixed resistance asymmetry, producing the classic MCSA stator-current sidebands at f(1 +/- 2s) whose amplitude scales with broken_bars/total_bars.

Permanent-magnet synchronous machines, two formulations. ':machine' = rotor dq frame, implicit-Euler 2x2 salient L_d/L_q solve, faithful port of the legacy sensors PmsmMachine, gravity-coupled (fault 'flux' + intrinsic rotor sag -> MCSA sideband), built for the FOC drive chain (FOC/SVPWM/inverter/Clarke/Park). ':dynamic' = abc frame, explicit Euler, non-salient, sinusoidal back-EMF (the sinusoidal counterpart of the trapezoidal BLDC) for a simpler standalone brushless dynamic. Both are world objects (FaultableNode -> TransformNode): local/parent_world + world, scene attach, variadic fault bank. Defaults: Maxon ECX PRIME 6M/16L.

Motor-agnostic electrical transducers. Current Sensor (Hall / shunt) with bandwidth, Gaussian noise and ADC quantization, usable on any current line: DC supply, PMSM stator phase (i_a/i_b/i_c) or rotor-frame (i_d/i_q). The same node is also registered as the legacy Physics.Electric.Motor.DC:currentSensor alias.
Rolling-element bearing fault generator: BPFO/BPFI/BSF/FTF characteristic frequencies computed from geometry and shaft speed, each with its own amplitude knob.
Shaft unbalance modulator (1× rotation frequency). Integrates shaft angle from omega input.
Gear mesh harmonic (n_teeth × shaft frequency) plus optional once-per-revolution Gaussian pulse for broken-tooth signatures.
Combined Coulomb + Stribeck + viscous friction torque. Editables can be driven over time to model wear.

Mechanical load sources. ':torque' = prescribed profiles (constant, step, ramp, quadratic K*omega^2, periodic) wired to a motor's tau_load. ':gravity-payload' = a crank payload whose weight m*g, projected through the motor orientation from the scene gravity latent, produces a 1x f_mech torque ripple (the dominant gravity -> i_q signature mechanism) plus axial/radial bearing loads; it scales with gravity (zero in microgravity) and shaft tilt.
Accelerometer transducer (1st-order LPF + Gaussian noise + quantization). Mechanical-domain counterpart to the Motor.DC tachymeter.
Generic sinusoidal fault modulator. Composable building block used to inject ad-hoc signatures into any signal stream.

Three independent 2nd-order LTI structural modes (one per body axis), the motor bracket that turns fault and environment forces into the acceleration an accelerometer reads. Parametrized by per-axis mass, natural frequency and damping ratio; implicit-Euler substepped, ported from the legacy sensors HousingMechanics with identical numerics. The vibration channel of the gravity-signature study.

Solid-phase particulate-matter descriptors (PM2.5, PM10, dust, lunar regolith). Wired to Physics.Scene:atmosphere-state through its variadic particulate_in_<k> config-link slot pool. V1 records the descriptor (id, characteristic diameter, material density, PM class) as binding metadata only; V2 will add a mass-loading state segment plus gravity-driven settling, drag, re-suspension, and filtration dynamics. Lives under Physics (not Chemistry) because particulates are solid matter governed by physics, not chemical species.
